name: Obadiah
summary: A prophet who saw a vision from the Lord GOD about Edom. He said Edom's pride would be brought down because it stood by and rejoiced when Judah was destroyed.

key_moments.title: Tells Edom Its Pride Will Fall
key_moments.description: In his vision Obadiah heard the LORD speak to Edom, who lived high in the clefts of the rock. Though Edom set its nest among the stars, the LORD said He would bring it down.

key_moments.title: Condemns Edom for Gloating Over Judah
key_moments.description: Obadiah said shame would cover Edom for its violence against its brother Jacob. Edom had stood by and rejoiced when strangers carried Jerusalem away, and as it had done, so it would be done to it.
